item.text: The read-only shell is blocked by a local sandbox error, so I’m using the supplied evidence. I’m separating opening interception from roadblock clearance and keeping both medics deployed through the artillery circuit; the prior lower-healing withdrawal left a critical survival gap.

Vanilla’s attack and DP skill gives the opening a concrete survival dependency: she must live until her first activation while holding the lower central attacker. I’m pairing that with Lancet’s healing, dedicated roadblock clearers, and an eastern arts battery. Their clearance and survival deadlines remain unverified.
